# openstatus_monitors (Data Source)

Lists OpenStatus monitors with optional pagination. Returns a list of monitors with their IDs, names, and types.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openstatus_monitors" "all" {
  limit = 100
}

output "monitor_count" {
  value = length(data.openstatus_monitors.all.monitors)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of monitors to return (default: 50, max: 100).
- `offset` (Number) Pagination offset.

### Read-Only

- `monitors` (List of Object) List of monitors. See [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitors).

<a id="nestedatt--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitors`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The ID of the monitor.
- `name` (String) Display name of the monitor.
- `type` (String) Monitor type (`http`, `tcp`, or `dns`).
